title: a search step's several place names
line: a search step whose place field carries more than one accurate name is tried name by name, every name named on the logged run's query; a connector that reads a place only as a state and a county, or not at all, builds one request for names of one place, so it is asked once and each name after it is logged as tried, its request not made again

steps.say: a search step on Raymond Earl Davidson for the 1950 census, the place field carrying the two ways the owner's records write his place

the real census connector builds the identical request for both names, state New York and county Nassau: it is asked once, the site answering nothing, and the second name is logged as tried with the request it repeated

logged_note.has: Hempstead, Nassau, New York, USA made the same request as Hempstead, Nassau, New York: not asked again

expect.why: one request goes out, not two (the list is the requests made, and the harness answers one); both names are tried, in order, none getting a hit: the logged run's query names every try, the last one tried, and the note names the name whose request the second repeated

steps.say: an obituary search step on Helen Sara Brant for the Archive's newspapers, the place field carrying the four names of Boca Raton the owner's catalog logged on a real run of the Archive's newspapers for an obituary at Boca Raton
